name: Kurohime
source:
Six boys and girls go camping to deepen mutual friendship. They get attacked by nanpa guys and lose their way finding shelter at a Western mansion in the mountains. However, they instantly get trapped by an earthquake in this monsters infested building. Can heroes survive? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
六名少男少女結伴露營，希望增進彼此的友誼。他們遭到一夥搭訕男子襲擊，逃跑途中迷失了方向，最後在山間一座西式宅邸裡找到容身之處。然而，一場突如其來的地震將他們困在了這棟怪物橫行的建築中。他們能活下來嗎？

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]］
